knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Priority reflects how often people pass and how serious a fall would be.
Moving stored goods is not part of housekeeping.
A wet walkway is a slip hazard until it is dry or controlled.

practicalCriteria: Walks a simulated warehouse area and prioritises slip and trip hazards before cleaning.
Clears and dries the highest-priority walkway within scope.
Escalates a simulated pallet obstruction and a damaged dock plate, with a record.
passRule: Hazards prioritised, highest-priority walkway cleared within scope, and out-of-scope items escalated. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Cleaning in an active traffic aisle
Stored goods moved by the cleaner
